description:
Deliverables:
- Make the Fly multi-region story operational instead of illustrative.
- Align the guide, telemetry expectations, and acceptance tests with a repeatable failover drill for durable clustered keys.

Acceptance:
- The guide and acceptance tests tell one coherent operator story for durable regional failover.
- The drill defines what recovered means and which telemetry proves it.
title: Turn region failover into an operator drill
